constraints: This tool is EVIDENCE, not authority: it reports what the code does, which supports a layout but does not prove one. Verify every offset against the GC target asm before adopting.

Field names are adopted ONLY from a candidate that matches the record size exactly and conflicts on no observed width; every other field stays unkNN. Never hand-edit a name in from a weaker candidate -- that is the invented-name failure AGENTS.md prohibits.
A MULTI-RECORD CLUSTER warning means the base covers two different records; split with --by-function before trusting the draft.
Always gate an actual conversion with: python tools/gdl/defake_gate.py check <unit> --rebuild. The draft proves nothing about codegen neutrality.
Clusters flagged with a load-update web (base += N) are protected by claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention -- convert around them, not through them.
name: structdraft
purpose: Draft a struct skeleton from the raw-offset accesses a TU already performs: clusters every observed base+CONST access by base expression, records the access WIDTH from each cast type, detects base+i*S+K striding to propose array-of-records, ranks candidate layouts from the TU's own file-local view structs, then include/game/*.h, then the Xbox PDB dump, and emits a padded C skeleton with unkNN fields and per-offset evidence comments ready for defake_rewrite.py.
usage: python tools/gdl/structdraft.py game/sfx/psfx.c --base row  # one cluster
python tools/gdl/structdraft.py --file old.c --root .  # draft from a historical revision (git show REV:path > old.c)
python tools/gdl/structdraft.py <unit> --verify <TypeName>  # score the draft against an already-recovered struct
